notes.title: Indie Dev Story - Patch V1.4 Released!
notes.content:
Hey all,

It's been great to see people playing and having fun!
I appreciate all the feedback and for letting me know about the bugs you have been encountering. I've just released a patch (V1.4) to address these bugs as well as adding some quality-of-life additions.

[h3]Achievement Unlocking Fix:[/h3]
The main reason for this patch was to resolve a problem with achievements sometimes not unlocking. There was basically a timing issue causing the unlocking to sometimes not get triggered. With all my testing I'm pretty sure I sorted it out now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081596/5b5b54c097266f294dc3f3de3b689e0277ed7341.gif[/img]

[h3]Here are the patch notes in full:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081596/bd8f321cc1c6a276795c57401e5fd0d2d6936e4e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixes for Steam Achievements sometimes not unlocking[/b]
[*] [b]Made it so the 'Release A Terrible Game' achievement unlocks if you get an end score of 10% or less now[/b] - The achievement says 10% but before it would only trigger if you got 9% or less, leading to confusion
[*] [b]Fixed the character being able to fall out of the rooms[/b]
[*] [b]Increased Auto-clicker detection threshold amount[/b] - This was triggering for some people who were not using an auto-clicker (People can legitimately click a lot faster than I imagined ha)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081596/3c0dbe295c115893708330233280c0fed91140e3.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a settings screen to the main menu and in-game exit menu[/b] - You can now independently set the volumes for Music, Clicking and General Gameplay. I also added a low graphics quality option
[*] [b]Can now access the How To Play screen from the in-game exit menu[/b]
[*] [b]Added a helper popup which will show if the player doesn't click for a period of time when first starting a game[/b] - To help people who don't realise that the game is a clicker and how to play (saw this issue on a persons Twitch stream)
[*] [b]Updated the launch splash screen to be of a higher quality[/b]
[*] [b]Updated the localisation[/b]
[*] [b]Made misc texts shorter to better fit in the UI[/b]
[/list]

Enjoy!
James
